capabilities: Render two-layer ruby annotations in reading and editing modes while showing raw markup in source mode
Skip over rendered ruby with smart arrow keys and reveal it by pressing the opposite direction
Convert between Markdown and HTML ruby syntax
disambiguation: Not related to the Ruby programming language; 'ruby' here means small gloss annotations rendered above or beside base text.
extras: Installation instructions are only an external link ('Refer to'). Licensed under PolyForm-Perimeter v1.0.1 since 2.0.1, previously GPL-3 and MIT; README states it stores no data, needs no internet, and has zero dependencies.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in rendering or editing support for ruby annotations, which are needed for furigana and similar layered gloss text.

relations.evidence: If you plan on using Advanced Ruby with Japanese text, install JADOU as well to unlock language-specific features.

relations.plugin: Japanese Novel Ruby Plugin for Obsidian

summary: Ruby annotation plugin that renders and edits two-layer ruby text, from Japanese furigana to layered commentaries, in reading and editing modes.
